notes: The source page is the Associate Degree General Studies Pattern I page (AA degree areas of emphasis: Creative Arts and Humanities; STEM; Society, Human Behavior and Culture), not the Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement. No section for the named award appears in the text, so no blocks are recorded.

The 'Total Units for the AA Degree 60', 'Units Required for the Area of Emphasis 18' and 'Cal-GETC Pattern 34' figures belong to the General Studies AA emphases, not to this certificate, so total_units, degree_total and ge_units stay null.
The text is cut off in the Society, Human Behavior and Culture emphasis list.
A reviewer should find the Moorpark College Cal-GETC certificate page, which likely lists the Cal-GETC areas and approved courses, to record this award.

Part 2: The source page is the Associate Degree General Studies Pattern I page (Creative Arts and Humanities, STEM, and Society/Human Behavior emphases for the AA), not the Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement. No section for the Cal-GETC certificate appears in the text, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers are recorded.
Part 2: Cal-GETC appears on the page only as an alternative GE pattern for the General Studies AA ('Cal-GETC Pattern 34'); those figures belong to the AA emphases, not this certificate.

Part 2: The Society, Human Behavior and Culture emphasis list is cut off after ANTH M02; many closed-list courses may appear in the untruncated page, but that list would still belong to the AA, not the certificate.
Part 2: Reviewer should locate the Cal-GETC certificate page in the 2026-2027 Moorpark catalog (likely a Cal-GETC certification/certificate of achievement page) to record its requirements.
